# Traefik — root-to-custom-context

Proxy at /, app on /app context, the proxy adding the prefix on the way in. Needs three things because Traefik rewrites no responses: SERVER_SERVLET_SESSION_COOKIE_PATH=/ for the session cookie, an X-Forwarded-Prefix=/ middleware, and FRAMEWORK so the backend stops building URLs with /app in them (without which Vaadin's csrfToken cookie stays on /app and every Hilla call is 401).

Proxy URL on `http://localhost:9090`: `/`

## Configuration

See [docker-compose.yml](./docker-compose.yml) for service definitions.

Traefik dynamic config (`vaadin.yml`), mounted into
`/etc/traefik/dynamic`:

```yaml
# Proxy at /, app on the /app context. The public URL stays at the root and the
# proxy adds the prefix when forwarding.
#
# This is the direction that costs the most behind a proxy which cannot touch a
# response. Two things have to be arranged, and both are in the compose file
# rather than here: the session cookie path, and the forwarded prefix that
# makes the backend stop building URLs with /app in them.
http:
  routers:
    vaadin:
      rule: PathPrefix(`/`)
      entryPoints:
        - web
      middlewares:
        - add-app
        - forwarded-root
        - compress
      service: vaadin

  services:
    vaadin:
      loadBalancer:
        servers:
          - url: http://vaadin:8080

  middlewares:
    add-app:
      addPrefix:
        prefix: /app

    # addPrefix does not emit X-Forwarded-Prefix — only stripPrefix does — so
    # it is set by hand here. The backend's context path is /app but its public
    # prefix is the root, and this is the only way to say so. Spring trims the
    # trailing slash, so getContextPath() ends up empty.
    #
    # "/" and not "": an empty value would REMOVE the header instead.
    forwarded-root:
      headers:
        customRequestHeaders:
          X-Forwarded-Prefix: "/"

    compress:
      compress:
        excludedContentTypes:
          - text/event-stream
          - text/plain
```

The entryPoints and the file provider come from the shared
[traefik.yml](../../traefik.yml), mounted read-only.
